name: Laban
overview: Laban, identified as the brother of Rebekah and son of Bethuel, plays a significant role in the narrative surrounding Abraham's servant and Jacob. When Abraham's servant arrives seeking a wife for Isaac, Laban warmly welcomes him, preparing his house and attending to the camels, demonstrating hospitality and care. This interaction sets the stage for Laban's later involvement with Jacob, including the marriages of his daughters to Jacob and the complex relationship that follows.
